# Qt standard widget translations

`qtbase_zh_CN.ts` is the unmodified Simplified Chinese Qt Base catalog from Qt Translations 6.11.2, tag `v6.11.2`, commit `570add0b7d3b1f2b7034b0bf41715456a238b29f`.

- Source: https://github.com/qt/qttranslations/tree/570add0b7d3b1f2b7034b0bf41715456a238b29f
- Catalog: `translations/qtbase_zh_CN.ts`
- Community attribution: `README.upstream`, copied from `translations/README`
- License rules: unmodified `licenseRule.json`
- Open-source license used here: LGPL-3.0-only, included in this directory

Qt LinguistTools compiles this source into `qtbase_zh_CN.qm`. Both M7Arc and its standalone extractor embed the catalog under `/i18n`; their standard widgets use it when the selected interface language is Simplified Chinese. English uses Qt's original strings and M7Arc's English application catalog.

To replace the catalog, edit the TS source and rebuild M7Arc. The release's Qt license notices include the catalog source location and LGPL terms.
